name: Cover figure
tokens: type.cover; type.subtitle; coverFigure; font.sansBold; font.sansMedium; darkPalette.cream; rhythm.detail.in10ToWins
sizes_dp_sp: 168 sp, line 1, tracking -6; coverFigure.marginLeft 0; no font scaling. Under in 10: cover.wins in type.subtitle 18/24 Jost 500, 8 dp gap (rhythm.detail.in10ToWins), cream, one line.
states: in10 (5-9): the 168 figure, cover.in10, and cover.wins must read alone (e.g. "7 / in 10 / Texans win" or "7 / de 10 / gana Texans"). Toss-up / Juego parejo if pFav < 0.55 (digit and cover.wins not shown). More than 9 in 10 if pFav >= 0.95, n stays 9, no cover.wins. Never 10.
fontScale: maxFontSizeMultiplier 1.0 (does not grow). At 1.3 the block stacks (coverFigure.stackFromFontScale). At 100% the 168 figure needs scroll to reach the footer.
a11y: contentDescription from tb.cover, which already names the favorite. Cream on bg 14.32:1 (light: inkOnBg 15.78). The figure is calculated: pFav = max(p, 1-p), n = clamp(round_half_up(pFav*10), 5, 9). cover.wins is visible text, not only in the description.

fontScale: Field labels type.fieldLabel 14/16, max 1.3. Geometry does not scale with font.
strings_keys: tb.field (model-only). Percents stay "72%" in both locales.
a11y: tb.field describes the favorite percent and the ring. Ring contrast modelOnPlayField 4.94:1. Ticks are texture only (1.72:1). 50% line cream 60% composites to 6.18:1. field.labelSeparateUnder is unused on primary fields after H2 (only one label).

a11y: Named favorite values, e.g. "Hawks 70% model". Cream on crimsonHero 6.12:1 in the end zones. Do not use blueHero in this UI.

name: Week row
tokens: type.kicker; type.teams; type.rowFigure; type.scoreRow; type.scoreName; type.fieldLabel; radius.none; teamLogos.sizeRow; nav.listPaddingBottom; rhythm.week
sizes_dp_sp: Min height rhythm.week.rowMinHeight 132 dp with 24 dp field. Logo column 24 dp. Row figure 48 sp. Time and state sit in a type.kicker 12/16 line ABOVE the names (not under them): when.* / chip.live / chip.final. Gap kicker to names 8, names to field 8, field to next 16 (or to a day header). PadX 16. Compact final scores type.scoreRow 22, names type.scoreName 18. Logo slot 24 dp, no color plate.
states: Upcoming, live, FINAL, tie. No Disagree chip, no market chip. 14-16 games, none featured. Typographic finals (winner 700, loser muted). Toss-up field label is chip.tossup, no name.
fontScale: type.teams max 1.5; type.rowFigure max 1.15; type.scoreRow max 1.3. Times and names nowrap; short name before ellipsis. Validate at 100, 135, 200%.
strings_keys: chip.final; chip.live; chip.tie; chip.tossup; cover.in10.short; when.*; tb.row
a11y: Row is one accessibility focus where possible. Logos: see Logo slot. Cream / muted on surface meet AA (12.34 / 5.69). type.rowFigureFinal (40 sans) is unused; compact finals use scoreRow.

name: Masthead
tokens: type.kicker; type.display; type.bodySmall; type.chip; field.stripHeight; motion.heroCollapseScroll; motion.duration; motion.easing; motion.reducedMotion; darkPalette.cream; darkPalette.muted; darkPalette.border
sizes_dp_sp: Expanded, top 16: WEEK / SEMANA type.kicker 12/16. Week number type.display 96/1 tracking -4, max 1.0, no font scaling. week.count 14/20 plus week.saved locale stamp. Public Alpha is a cream-outline chip (1.5 dp stroke, radius 4, pad 8 x 4, type.chip 11/14, key alpha, not a muted kicker). Orbs for adjacent weeks, 40 dp diameter, 4 dp gap, current orb cream ring 2 dp. Strip field field.stripHeight 72, only the model O, same geometry as the row field at 3x height. Collapse uses transform, not fontSize: start 0, compactFrom 80, compactVisible 120 (motion.heroCollapseScroll). Compact bar 64: week.kicker plus the week number type.titleCompact 22/28, the chip, no orbs, no strip, saved stamp stays. Duration lg 320, easing cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1). Reduced motion: snap at compactFrom, keep every element that belongs in the compact bar, do not hide content.
states: Expanded and collapsed. Week switcher via orbs (hapticEvents.weekChange selectionAsync). Offline with cache: stamp plus banner. Offline no cache: empty state, not a hollow masthead.
fontScale: type.display max 1.0 (same rule as the cover figure). type.titleCompact max 1.3. The Public Alpha chip must not truncate. Wordmark never splits if it appears.
strings_keys: week.kicker; week.title; week.count; week.saved; week.choose; alpha
a11y: English default. Stamp uses locale format. Contrast cream on bg 14.32:1 (light: inkOnBg 15.78). heroCollapse is in hapticEvents.never. Orbs expose week.choose and the week number.

name: FINAL kicker
surface: Week row; Detail hero; widget (if the next game is final, not the default next-kickoff state)
tokens: type.kicker; type.figureLg; type.scoreRow; type.scoreName; font.sansBold; darkPalette.cream; darkPalette.muted
sizes_dp_sp: Kicker 12/16 sp, IBM Plex Mono 500, letter-spacing 1.2, uppercase (renders FINAL / FINAL). Detail scores type.figureLg 32/36 mono 600 tabular. Week compact scores type.scoreRow 22/24 mono 600 tabular, names type.scoreName 18/24. Winner Jost 700 cream (light: ink). Loser Jost 400 muted. No cream 24 dp circle, no check stamp.
states: FINAL / FINAL. LIVE / EN JUEGO (chip.live) and TIE / EMPATE (chip.tie) use the same kicker token. On FINAL, replace the 168 cover and the countdown with the score pair; keep the field if useful, no model ring pulse. Live: show chip.live and detail.livekicker, hide countdown, do not pulse, keep the pre-kickoff probability.
fontScale: max 1.5. Must stay one line.
a11y: contentDescription is the visible word. Pair with typographic scores, not with a mark.

sizes_dp_sp: 14/20 sp, Jost 400. Tappable row >= 48 dp.
states: Always the experiment line plus a link to How it is calculated. No market mention.
fontScale: max 1.5. Spanish is longer; wrap, do not truncate.
a11y: Link has an explicit role and name ("How it is calculated" / "Cómo se calcula"). Muted on bg 6.6:1, cream link 14.32:1.

states: Filled cream for n, empty #30363C for the rest. Never 10 of 10.
fontScale: Geometry does not scale. The cover phrase around it follows type.subtitle / body at max 1.5, except the 168 figure.
a11y: Decorative relative to tb.cover; hide from a11y tree or mark as hidden so the phrase is not read twice.

fontScale: Labels max 1.5. Log loss uses a period in EN (0.559) and a comma in ES (0,559).
strings_keys: hist.title; hist.sub; hist.honest; how.honest; hist.calls; hist.calls.note; tb.dumbbell
a11y: tb.dumbbell describes both marks as reference, not as a pick. O contrast 4.94, X 7.11 on the play field. No logos on week-level dumbbells.

name: Widget 4x1
tokens: widget.size4x1; type.widgetFigureSm; type.widgetPhrase; type.kicker

a11y: Tap endzone://game/{id}. contentDescription is the kicker plus the named figure. Must not truncate at 100% or 135% with Estrellas / Atlantic.

name: Logo slot
surface: Week rows, Detail header (and compact bar), widget 4x2. Not 2x2, not 4x1. Not on History week-level dumbbells.
tokens: teamLogos.flag; teamLogos.sizeRow; teamLogos.sizeHeader; teamLogos.sizeBar; teamLogos.cacheTtlDays; darkPalette.surfaceRaised; darkPalette.border
sizes_dp_sp: 24 dp on Week rows, widget 4x2, and the compact Detail bar. 32 dp on the Detail heading. No color plate behind the logo, no color border. The logo is never an accent.
states: Flag teamLogos.enabled. If off: skip to monogram. If on: disk cache keyed by team id (TTL 7 days), then network (public nflverse URLs at runtime), then monogram. On the boards the loaded state is a generic #30363C circle or shield labeled "team logo (runtime)". Logos are not stored in the repo or the APK. Kit and site do not change.
fontScale: Slot size is fixed in dp and does not scale with font.
strings_keys: logo.cd; logo.cd.loading; logo.caption (annotation only, never inside the 24-32 dp slot)
a11y: contentDescription "{team} logo" / "Logo de {team}" when a logo is showing or loading (logo.cd / logo.cd.loading). Do not download or imitate real marks in mocks or in the APK.

name: Monogram
surface: Fallback for the logo slot (flag off, cache miss plus network failure, or load error)

sizes_dp_sp: Same 24 or 32 dp slot. 2 or 3 letter fictional abbreviation, Jost 700. Team color is a 1.5 dp ring or a 5 dp dot, never a solid fill. Text cream on #262B30.
states: Default variant: ring. Dot is an allowed alternative, shown on H2_logos.png. Abbreviations and ring colors are fictional (not NFL codes or palettes).
fontScale: Type size inside the slot is fixed (about 8 sp at 24 dp, 10 sp at 32 dp) and does not follow the cover figure.
a11y: contentDescription "{team}" / "{team}" (logo.cd.mono), not "{team} logo". Cream on surface 12.34:1 (AA). The ring is a 1.5 dp graphic; use fictional muted colors, not real NFL colors.

tokens: themePref; langOption.minHeight; langOption.radio; type.body; type.kicker; contrastDark; contrastLight; lightPalette; darkPalette
sizes_dp_sp: Same pattern as Language selector: section kicker set.theme, then three options, each minHeight 48 dp, radio 20 dp, type.body 16/24. Gap between Language and Theme sections: space.md 16. Default themePref.default system, storageKey theme.pref.
states: Auto / Auto (follows the phone, key set.theme.auto); Dark / Oscuro; Light / Claro. Selected radio is cream in dark and ink in light. Light palette is lightPalette (bg #F4EEDF, ink #151515, model #22509B, crimsonHero #AE2440 with cream 5.80:1 on end zones, fieldTick #BAB3A4 texture 1.59:1, 50% line textMuted 5.29:1). No yellow on primary surfaces in either theme.
fontScale: type.body max 1.5. Labels must not truncate.
a11y: Radio group. contentDescription is the option label plus selected state. Changing theme uses no haptic (not a toggle switch). Contrast: dark cream on surface 12.34:1; light inkOnSurface 13.88:1.

name: Cache control
tokens: hitSlop.min; type.body; type.kicker; type.bodySmall; space.md
sizes_dp_sp: Section kicker set.cache. One row minHeight 48 dp: locale stamp set.cache.when ("Saved {dt}" / "Guardado {dt}") in type.kicker muted, plus a text button set.clear ("Clear" / "Borrar") in type.body cream (light: model or ink), hit 48 dp. Section gap space.md 16 after Theme.
states: With cache: stamp plus Clear. After clear: set.cache.cleared, then set.cache.empty, button disabled until new data is saved. No haptic on clear. Does not log the user out (there is no account). Date uses the locale format, same as week.saved.
fontScale: type.body max 1.5. Spanish "Datos guardados" and "Guardado {dt}" must wrap, not clip.
a11y: The button role is "Clear" / "Borrar". Announce set.cache.cleared after a successful clear. Muted stamp meets AA (dark 6.6:1, light 6.01:1).

name: Countdown
tokens: type.subtitle; font.monoMedium; motion.duration; motion.easing; rhythm.detail
sizes_dp_sp: type.subtitle 18/24, or type.figure 16/20 mono 500 tabular-nums, cream (light: ink), placed under the date (gap rhythm.detail.kickerToDate 8) or under cover.wins (16 dp) if it competes with the kicker. Updates every 60 s. Numbers use duration.sm 120 and easing standard, never springShape (no bounce).
states: d >= 1: detail.countdown "Starts in {d} d {h} h" / "Empieza en {d} d {h} h". d = 0 and h >= 1: detail.countdown.short. Under 1 hour: detail.countdown.min. At kickoff or live: hide countdown, show chip.live and detail.livekicker. FINAL: hide countdown, show typographic scores. Reduced motion: still update the text, no tween on the digits.
fontScale: max 1.5, one line, nowrap. Validate at 100 and 135%.
a11y: contentDescription is the visible sentence. Do not announce every 60 s tick; only when the user focuses the Detail or when the state changes to live or FINAL. Cream on bg 14.32:1 (light inkOnBg 15.78).

name: Motion and haptics
tokens: motion.duration; motion.easing; motion.stagger; motion.springShape; motion.heroCollapseScroll; motion.reducedMotion; hapticEvents; opacity.pressed
sizes_dp_sp: Durations 120 / 200 / 320 ms. Easing cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1). List stagger 30 ms on the first 6 Week rows (enter only). Pressed opacity 0.72. Masthead collapse as in Masthead. Spring only for brand shapes on first-run, empty, and offline-no-cache: damping 16, stiffness 180, mass 1, overshootClamping false.
states: Reduced motion (OS setting): durations 1 ms, disableSpring true, keepContent true, collapse snaps at compactFrom 80, digits still update. Haptics allow: weekChange and navChange selectionAsync; switchOn impactLight / AndroidHaptics.Toggle_On; switchOff impactLight / AndroidHaptics.Toggle_Off. hapticEvents.never: probabilityUpdate, heroCollapse, refresh, finalResult, modelHit, skeletonPulse, and cache clear.
fontScale: Motion does not change type sizes. Collapse must not tween fontSize.
a11y: Respect the OS reduce-motion flag. Haptics are optional and never required to understand a state. Do not add new haptic events without updating hapticEvents.

name: Day header
tokens: type.kicker; rhythm.week.dayHeaderGapAbove; rhythm.week.dayHeaderGapBelow; darkPalette.cream
sizes_dp_sp: type.kicker 12/16 mono 500, tracking 1.2, uppercase, cream (light: ink). Gap 16 above (8 if it is the first header under the masthead) and 8 below, both on the 4 dp scale. PadX 16. Hairline optional 1 dp in border, full content width, 8 dp under the label, not required.
states: Today / Hoy (week.day.today) or Tomorrow / Mañana (week.day.tomorrow) when it applies; otherwise the locale weekday via week.day ({weekday}), which type.kicker uppercases. Groups the rows of that kickoff day. Do not invent a market or timezone kicker here (times stay in the row kicker, phone-local).
fontScale: max 1.5, one line. Must not truncate.
a11y: Headers are headings in the accessibility tree. Cream on bg 14.32:1 (light inkOnBg 15.78).
